description: This file contains the initial schema definition for a crowdfunding platform using PostgreSQL. It defines core entities such as users, projects, pledges, rewards, transactions, and related supporting tables. It includes table creation, constraints, indexes, trigger functions for maintaining data integrity, and some seed data.

methods.name: gen_project_slug
methods.description: Generates a URL-friendly slug for projects based on title if not provided, ensuring uniqueness.

methods.name: touch_updated_at
methods.description: Updates the updated_at timestamp on record modifications.

methods.name: enforce_reward_quantity
methods.description: Checks reward availability and increments claimed count when pledges are made.

methods.name: apply_transaction_effects
methods.description: Automatically updates pledge status and project amount when transactions succeed or are refunded.

methods.name: enforce_currency_consistency
methods.description: Ensures pledge and transaction currencies match the related project or pledge.

methods.name: evaluate_project_status
methods.description: Automates project status updates based on funding progress and deadlines.
